runs.note: Recorded on 2026-10-13, after the run, which kept neither its model nor its command. The meeting of 2026-05-06 chose OpenCLIP's PE-Core-bigG-14-448 with the meta weights for this classifier, and the report of 2026-05-20 that analyzes these predictions says the same classifier made them. The run came before 2026-05-28, when twenty of its rows entered magick_dev/predictions.csv (ce9d44c). On all thirty dev images, ViT-L-14 with the openai weights, the classifier's default, gives class scores 0.07 to 0.59 apart from the rows here, so the default did not make this file. A rerun of PE-Core-bigG-14-448 with the meta weights on the thirty dev images, on CUDA on 2026-10-13 at video-bokeh c768fdc with OpenCLIP 3.3.0 and torch 2.11.0+cu130, gave the same top subject and top style as the rows here on all thirty, with class scores within 0.0107 (median 0.0019), which confirms the model. The original run used an earlier GPU, an RTX 3090 or 4090 by Slava's recollection, and the rerun the lab machine's RTX 5090, which may account for that residual.
